results.title: eBumbeni Community Protests Escalate Over 15-Year Service Delivery Crisis in Mpumalanga
results.description: HAZYVIEW, Mpumalanga — The eBumbeni community protests over a prolonged lack of service delivery have intensified, with frustrated residents blocking the main road with rocks and burning tyres to demand immediate municipal intervention. results.title: Four Murderers and a Scapegoat - Leftism is a deadly disease.
results.description: Our society is unwell. We see this in a thousand different ways. Regular church attendance has declined significantly over three generations. Marriage rates are down; divorce rates are up. An increasing percentage of women choose not to have children; an increasing percentage of men choose not to settle down. For its part, the entertainment industry glorifies selfishness, violence, vanity, promiscuity, abortion-on-demand, immediate gratification, and overindulgence, while mocking religion, hard work, compassion, fidelity, strong marriages, committed parents, and healthy families.
